references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord, make his paths straight. This refers to the preparation and clearing of the way for the Messiah, which John the Baptist carried out.
John the Baptist calls people to repentance to prepare the way for the Lord, reflecting John's role and message.
This verse speaks about genuine repentance and righteousness, something John also urged the Pharisees and Sadducees to pursue.
John speaks of the coming judgment and the need for true repentance, paralleling John the Baptist's warning to the Pharisees and Sadducees.
Jesus calls the Pharisees 'a brood of vipers,' which recalls John's words 'offspring of vipers'; both express condemnation of hypocrisy.
John the Baptist warns people not to rely on their descent from Abraham for righteousness, but rather to show genuine repentance, similar to his message in Matthew.
